title: Workspace authority checkpoint
what_is_remembered: Which workspace authority was granted, dirty-buffer identity, journal links, trusted roots, and active worksets.
what_is_not_remembered: The live authority handle, credential bodies, or buffer contents — authority is re-resolved on restore.

available_actions.accessible_label: Clear the remembered workspace authority checkpoint for this workspace only

caveats: Clearing forgets the remembered grant; the next open re-resolves authority and never touches buffer contents.
